svg.title: Karta metrics exporter: startup, ownership, status, failures and recovery

g.text: Karta metrics exporter: startup, ownership, status, failures and recovery
One exporter process: logical components, not separate services
Illustrative execution of the simplified branch. This is not a captured cluster trace.
Example: namespace demo; JobSet train (UID js-1) -> Job train-worker-0 (UID job-1) -> Pod train-worker-0-a (UID pod-1).
Each stage explains one path. Source callbacks, different queue keys and HTTP collection can overlap.
The JobSet controller writes JobSet status. Its own reconciliation is outside this exporter diagram.
A. Load configuration and reject invalid startup
[invalid config / Kubernetes config / CEL compile failure]
B. Construct one dependency graph before serving
Runtime owns every Kubernetes source stream, including Karta definitions.
Inventory is a synchronous selection helper. It has no watcher or worker.
Reader shares accepted full objects and caches intermediate-owner metadata.
C. Start workers, source synchronization and HTTP together
A queue key is processed once at a time in its queue.
Different roots can reconcile concurrently. Calculation runs outside Runtime's lock.
Publication commit returns under that lock to reject obsolete work.
D. Establish Kubernetes source streams and their evidence
LIST/WATCH callbacks belong to Runtime. sourceObject keeps provenance outside Kubernetes fields.
A delayed callback does not receive a fresh lifetime just because it was delivered late.
ResourceVersion (RV) is checked for equality; it is not compared numerically across resources.
E. Elect the definition and plan namespaces / resource watches
With no namespaceSelector, a namespaced resource uses an all-namespace watch.
Cluster-scoped resources normalize to empty namespace and reuse one watch key.
Known definitions enable root discovery even when no Pods exist.
F. Accept a Pod change and queue its discovery
G. Follow controller ownership: Pod -> Job -> JobSet
[matching fresh metadata exists from earlier work / priming]
No controller owner ends the path. Non-controller ownerReferences are not traversed.
An explicitly ignored next-owner GVK stops at the current object: ignored_owner.
A missing owner, UID mismatch, cycle or path over 1024 objects does not invent a root.
Kubernetes scope determines whether the next GET uses demo or empty namespace.
H. Confirm the root representation and register path dependencies
[dynamically discovered root kind lacks a full observation]
A definition chooses interpretation after ownership determines the root.
It does not stop traversal merely because an intermediate Job has a Karta.
Unknown non-Pod roots can still have generic ownership rows and creation time.
A standalone Pod without a Karta is excluded by this implementation.
I. A root with zero Pods uses the same root calculation
Zero Pods does not imply Undefined or absence of the workload.
A known root can publish creation and normalized status with an empty PodPages list.
Pod mapping work is skipped when there are no attached Pods.
J. Snapshot inputs and prepare separate creation / interpretation proofs
Definition failure can invalidate interpretation without erasing independently proven creation time.
Merged evidence takes the earliest expiry and all required dependencies.
Pod mapping additionally requires its complete ownership path and Pod proof.
K. Evaluate workload status from the full JobSet object
The exporter does not sum Pod phases or child Job states into workload status.
JobSet's own controller already wrote the counts and conditions on the root.
Successful evaluation with no matches yields Undefined. No StatusDefinition yields no status series.
JQ/extraction failure is evaluation_failed, not an application Failed phase.
L. Resolve workload-status labels before the Pod loop
M. Map each changed Pod, then resolve its custom labels
The child component has Kind=Job, but its spec accessor still reads the JobSet.
Pod selectors read the Pod through a separate PodQuerier.
replica_group_id comes from ReplicaSelector, not GangScheduling group-by fields.
A missing required instance or invalid selector result is a mapping error.
Workload results are cached for this immutable root object across metrics and Pods.
Pod evaluation uses the current Pod. Rules compile once, outside reconciliation.
An error can be retained even if a later source succeeds: report evaluation_failed health.
Cancellation aborts the call. Bad / absent custom labels do not become an application phase.
N. Build rows and atomically reject superseded calculations
Publishing transfers ownership of nested maps and slices. They remain immutable.
An old computation cannot make a new source generation valid.
These guards are concurrency protection, not a second ownership discovery algorithm.
O. Prometheus pulls only a captured publication view
Full metric names start with karta_. Status and Pod rows carry observation_valid=true/false.
Invalid known rows can remain visible with false. Workload failure adds observation_valid health=0.
Scraping makes no Kubernetes request and runs no JQ or CEL.
A captured view is consistent at Capture(); a later invalidation affects the next capture.
Readiness is not workload readiness. An optional selected kind can fail without blocking /readyz.
Resource-type observation health still reports that failure.
P. Reuse unchanged Pod results while refreshing the root publication
Q. Discovery, API and evaluation failures retain honest validity
Not every evaluation error is a queue error: some are published as failed evidence.
Known values are not converted into a fake application Failed state.
Without a previous successful status there may be no status series to retain.
A first unresolved Pod has no confirmed root publication to fabricate.
R. Refresh sources and ownership proofs before they expire
[same UID and RV, accepted object still compatible]
Initial Pod sync also primes metadata for referenced owner groups, then traverses upward.
That optimization can avoid one API GET per Pod. It does not replace UID/path validation.
An unchanging watch stream alone does not grant permanent freshness.
S. Recover sources without reviving old evidence
[normal watch cursor expiration / unsupported initial events]
[permission / API failure, or Karta stream closes]
Old failure generations remain invalid while any current publication refers to them.
A successful unrelated read cannot make old rows trustworthy.
Failure keys are released when their publication / health references disappear.
T. Deletion, reparenting and namespace exclusion
U. Shut down workers, serving and telemetry
The in-memory publication store is rebuilt on the next process start.
No new deployment, cluster request or workload execution was performed to create this explanation.
Purple [decision] = state transition or validity decision
Yellow notes = explanation; pink notes = failure or limit
